disclaimer: All datasets are curated from authoritative open space agencies (NASA Planetary Data System, USGS Astrogeology, ESA Planetary Science Archive, NASA Earthdata LP DAAC, and CGIAR-CSI). No citations or URLs are fabricated.

datasets.dataset_name: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record (GDR) Digital Elevation Model
datasets.organization: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) / Planetary Data System (PDS)
datasets.used_for: Topographic morphology, crater rim slope inclination calculations, and surface roughness (TRI) quantification for lunar landing candidates.
relevant_variables: elevation_m (radial elevation in meters referenced to Moon sphere R=1737.4 km)
datasets.spatial_resolution: Up to 512–1024 pixels/deg (~30 m to 60 m/pixel at lunar poles)
datasets.license_usage: NASA Open Data Policy / US Government Public Domain (Free for scientific, commercial, and educational reuse)

datasets.dataset_name: LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment Reduced Data Record (RDR)
datasets.organization: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) / NASA GSFC / PDS Geosciences Node
datasets.used_for: Cryogenic thermal modeling of lunar polar permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) and diurnal temperature range benchmarking.
relevant_variables: temperature_min_k (extreme cold trap minimum brightness temperature, down to 40 K)
temperature_max_k (subsolar maximum surface temperature, up to 395 K)
rock_abundance_fraction (areal fraction of boulders >1 m visible in infrared)
datasets.spatial_resolution: 128 pixels/deg global (~240 m/pixel; targeted polar products at 50 m/pixel)
datasets.license_usage: NASA Open Data Policy / Public Domain

datasets.dataset_name: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (MEGDR)
datasets.organization: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / NASA PDS Geosciences Node
datasets.used_for: Global Martian reference elevation datum, regional slope baselines, and delta/crater rim topographic profiles (Jezero, Gale, Valles Marineris).
datasets.spatial_resolution: 128 pixels/deg (~463 meters per pixel at equator)
datasets.license_usage: NASA Open Data Policy / US Government Public Domain

datasets.dataset_name: MRO Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM)
datasets.organization: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU-APL) / NASA PDS
datasets.used_for: Surface mineralogy identification, clay and hydrated sulfate detection, and lithological classification for ancient lacustrine sediments.
relevant_variables: primary_lithology (Fe/Mg phyllosilicates, olivine-rich basalts, carbonate precipitates)
dust_cover_index (ratio of loose atmospheric dust coating)
datasets.spatial_resolution: 18–36 meters per pixel (Targeted mode); 100–200 m/px (Survey mode)
datasets.license_usage: NASA Open Data Policy / Public Domain

datasets.dataset_name: NASA/NGA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) Global 1-Arcsecond DEM
datasets.organization: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) / National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) / USGS EROS
datasets.used_for: Terrestrial analog digital elevation models, calculating topographic slope degrees, and deriving 3x3 window Terrain Ruggedness Index (TRI).

datasets.dataset_name: NASA Terra/Aqua MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 / MYD11A1 Version 6.1)
datasets.organization: NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC) / NASA Earthdata
datasets.used_for: Diurnal surface radiometric temperature minimums and maximums across terrestrial analog candidate zones (Atacama, Antarctica, Death Valley).
datasets.spatial_resolution: 1,000 meters (1 km gridded sinusoidal tile projection)
datasets.license_usage: NASA Earth Science Open Data (Public Domain / Free and Unrestricted)

datasets.dataset_name: Global Aridity Index and Potential Evapotranspiration (ET0) Database Version 3
datasets.organization: CGIAR Consortium for Spatial Information (CGIAR-CSI) / Zomer & Trabucco
datasets.used_for: Quantifying continuous climatic desiccation and hyper-aridity levels for comparison with planetary hyper-arid soil analogs.
relevant_variables: aridity_index (dimensionless ratio: Mean Annual Precipitation / Reference Evapotranspiration)
annual_precipitation_mm (mean annual moisture input in mm/year)

datasets.organization: Hartmann & Moosdorf (University of Hamburg) / USGS ScienceBase
datasets.used_for: Classifying terrestrial analog regional lithology into major rock classes (basalt, anorthosite, evaporites, siliciclastics) for geologic similarity pairing.
relevant_variables: primary_lithology (mafic volcanic rock, basic plutonic rock, evaporites, siliciclastic sediments)
dominant_minerals (plagioclase feldspar, pyroxene, olivine, gypsum, halite)
datasets.spatial_resolution: Vector polygon database (~1:1,000,000 equivalent map scale)
